pages.text:
- Coal coke: fuel and reagent for the Arcforge Furnace, and a long-burning furnace fuel.
- Carbon dust: crushed coal. Bakes into coal coke with no creosote.
- Creosote: burns in the Fuel Burner (to 850°C), treats wood in the Infuser, and distils into oils and pitch. Coal and Bio-Coal make it (250 mB each); logs bake into charcoal with 100 mB.
- Slag: left over from the Arcforge Furnace. Spin it into Slag Wool in a Fiberizer.
